# Flatkey

Flatkey is a Technology, Information and Internet company. flatkey is a company that offers a platform for AI models, focused creation tools, and a playground for testing ideas before building. They provide curated model collections, practical use cases, rankings, guides, and platform updates. Flatkey employs 3 people. Headquartered in San Jose, California, United States.

Flatkey is a unified access layer for AI — one API key connecting teams to 328+ official models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM and more) with transparent pricing, automatic failover, and costs as low as 50% off official rates.

# SwiftKey

SwiftKey is a Information Technology & Services company. SwiftKey employs 95 people (+20.3% YoY, +16 people) and has an annual revenue of GBP7.9M, founded in 2008. Headquartered in London, United Kingdom. Its workforce is distributed across United Kingdom, Mexico, South Korea, and United States.

## About

SwiftKey's mission is to enhance interaction between people and technology. We're best known for our predictive keyboard apps that learn from you to make typing on touchscreens faster and easier. We also work directly with mobile manufacturers and worldwide, our technology features on more than 250 million devices.

Headquartered in Southwark, central London, SwiftKey was founded in 2008. We also have offices in San Francisco, US, and Seoul, Korea.
